name: OpenAI Customer Service Agents Demo
description: Airline customer-service demo with a multi-agent Python backend on the OpenAI Agents SDK and a Next.js chat UI.
whatItDoes: It simulates an airline support desk where specialised agents handle requests such as seat changes, flight status and cancellations, while the UI visualises routing between them. A reference for teams prototyping support agents.
howItWorks: A FastAPI backend implements triage and specialist agents with handoffs, tools and guardrails using the Agents SDK. A Next.js frontend built on ChatKit shows the conversation alongside agent and guardrail events.
